purpose: Required coverage, not a success receipt. Missing, truncated or unaligned evidence is incomplete.

comparison_rules.pixels: retain whole-frame and separate playfield/HUD/text metrics; report masks and tolerances explicitly; no pixel-identity claim from aggregate similarity
comparison_rules.audio: separate requested events, dispatched variants, PCM/loop alignment and synthesizer timbre
comparison_rules.source_identity: fingerprint original EXE, input RPY/config, runtime code and harness for each run
comparison_rules.coverage: A modality passing for one case cannot satisfy another case or another modality.
